_notes: Recorded by HeightmapFixtures.java through CaptureVanillaScenarios -p:CaptureFixtures=heightmaps. A real 26.3 dedicated server supplies dimension types and registries. Each isolated native LevelChunk starts empty and receives setBlockState edits on the server thread; no world generation or neighboring-block notifications change the column. Each checkpoint records getHeight + 1 (first free Y) at the edited column, and getRawData for all four runtime maps. Predicates call every Heightmap.Types.isOpaque predicate for every Block.BLOCK_STATE_REGISTRY state in numeric order. Packed words are vanilla padded little-entry-order longs, relative to dimension minY; the packet uses the client subset of these maps.
